(Appears as 1.253.686 in game)
Hello claymates!
We have a small fix for you this hotfix, but one that we have seen you all reporting so we wanted to make sure it got into your hands before our next patch. The fix is:
Fixed the level 50 achievement (Supreme Grandmaster) not always unlocking

We are continuing to track your reports, so if you're experiencing any issues, please do keep reporting via support@doublefine.com with your device information and any screenshots/details you can provide.

Kiln 2.0.1 Hotfix - Sept 6, 2026
(Appears as v1.246.799 in game)
Thank you to everyone who has tried out our recent Bisque update! We’re so excited that it’s finally in your hands, and seeing your Daily Throw creations has been amazing for the whole team to see.

As with any major update like this, we’re tracking any issues that have cropped up, so please do keep reporting via support@doublefine.com with your device and any screenshots/details you can provide.

To start, the team has put together a hotfix – for anyone who’s unfamiliar, hotfixes are smaller, more targeted updates to fix more pressing issues that you all might be facing! In this case, we have two main fixes for you below:
Fixed an issue where Custom matches would show incorrect pause menu information.
Fixed some shop items, which were incorrectly locked from being accessed (those higher levels should be available now!)
That’s it for now– thank you all for playing Kiln, and for helping us improve the experience!
(Appears as v1.246.297 in game)
Hello and welcome one and all to the biggest Kiln updates to date! Thank you all so much for your patience and support in the last several weeks as Double Fine regained its indie-pendence!

None of that meant we stopped working on Kiln though – and we can’t wait to share this exciting update with you all! Be sure to check out our blog post for a deeper run down of the new features, but without further ado: The Bisque Update.

notes.title: As always, let’s recap some of the top highlights

items.text: A BRAND NEW creative mode: The Daily Throw 🎨
Weekly Quests to earn extra Chips‼️
Moving to Player-Hosted Matches⚠️
Custom Games with up to 8-Players 🎮
All New Pot Journal to keep track of your pots 📓
Expanded Collection Size to collect even more pots 💾
Two New Maps: Poseidon 🌊 and Ra 🌞
New Level Cap of 60 ⬆️
And Two New Decoration Packs: Psychonauts 2 and Sun & Surf Decoration Packs
Plus a New Indie Price, now is the time to get your friends on the wheel! 🏺
Phew. Check out the full notes below!
✨ What’s New ✨

Added Daily Throw, which allows you to compete for rewards by submitting your most creative pot for the daily prompt to earn ribbons from other players, earn Chips and XP and bestow ribbons of your very own.
Added two new maps: Ra's Rise and Shine Nursery and Poseidon's Bubble Bath!
Added the Pot Journal, which includes details and statistics about each pot shape.
Added Weekly Quests, which grant Chips or XP for completing them.
Added Custom Matches– Play with a party of up to 8, on the map of your choosing, with a shared lobby!
Added Candy, Pottery Basics, Rainbow Unicorn, and Succulent pot decorations to the game
Added a ton of new glazes 🫟
⬆️Updated⬆️
Increased level cap to 60!
Increased Collection size to 80, plus it scrolls now!
Matches are now player-hosted! This was an important step for us to preserve long-term game health.
Note: In the case of a host disconnection, the game will nominate a new host and the match will continue after a brief refresh.
Improved performance and stability
🔧Fixed🔧
Various combat and bot fixes
Various audio, SFX, and VFX fixes
Various UI fixes

As we continue to build on Kiln, we are continuing to investigate other issues you all report, but every report helps! If you are experiencing any problems, please write into support@doublefine.com with your device and any screenshots/details you can provide). Especially as we enter this new indie era and move to player-hosted servers, we appreciate any reports you send our way with logs and recordings! It helps a ton 💚
Thank you all again for your support and playing Kiln! We continue to work on new ways to play, and a new way for you to connect and save your account, so stay tuned for more from us.

Added safeguards to avoid loss of save data – this will not restore a save that has been lost, but should prevent any future save data loss. If you continue to experience this, please write into support@doublefine.com and we will take a closer look!
This issue was a high priority for us and warranted an update all its own, but we will let you know more news about Kiln as soon as we’re able to.

Of course, we continue to investigate other issues you all report, but every report helps! If you are experiencing any problems, please write into support@doublefine.com with your device and any screenshots/details you can provide).
A huge thanks to every claymate who has taken the time to play Kiln! We appreciate you all for spending some time in the Wedge and on the bottlefield with us ❤️

items.text: (Appears as 1.236.608 in game)

A new update has landed into the fray! This update includes some improvements, some bug fixes, and some prep for our bigger Summer update, Mission Criti-Bowl from our launch roadmap. We are also working on an updated roadmap for you all, so stay tuned for that!

notes.title: Your top highlights for this update

items.text: There’s sorting in the shop now! 🎉You can filter things based on locked/purchased, theme, and glazes by type

We’ve made adjustments to the idle timer in Quench to help address running into idle players in matches. We know it’s not a permanent solution and are still investigating ways to continue to improve this!
Fixed an issue in which some players were joining games as spectators – thank you to everyone who helped us track this issue down! 💜
Check out the full notes below!
✨ What’s New ✨

notes.title: A variety of Slip’s Shop improvements, including

items.text: Added sorting for items in Slip’s Shop, allowing you to filter by locked/purchased, the item’s theme, and a glaze’s edge treatment
The shop shows items are available to unlock at higher levels 🙌
You can now sort by ascending and descending order
Adjustments to idle timer in Quench to help address idle players in matches
⬆️Updated⬆️
Improved performance, especially around water in the game

notes.title: Various Keyboard and Mouse Support Improvements, including

items.text: Added support for International Keyboards
Keyboard prompts should now show when using a keyboard on Xbox Console
🔧Fixed🔧
Fixed an issue in which some players were joining games as spectators
Fixed tracking for the Solid Gold Achievement – please let us know if you’re still experiencing this issue by writing in to support!
Fixed several specific Glazes not applying properly
‘Woof Spout’ now can have Glaze applied to it
Some general Bot fixes
Various combat fixes
Various VFX fixes, including an improved Kintsugi Glow ✨
Various UI fixes
Various Audio and SFX fixes

As always, we are continuing to investigate your reports, but every report helps! If you are experiencing any problems, please write into support@doublefine.com with your device and any screenshots, videos or details you can provide.

We are also continuing to track feedback (be sure to fill out our feedback survey with any specific thoughts), so please keep telling us what you think and what you’d like to see or drop some threads in our feedback forum on Discord.
Known Issue - Getting Stuck on the Bot during Tutorial

When the Bot drops into the Tutorial arena, you may find yourself stuck on the bot. If you roll (Left Trigger on Controller, Shift on Keyboard and Mouse), you should be able to get unstuck. Jumping (A on Controller, Space on Keyboard and Mouse) repeatedly can also get you unstuck.
If you remain stuck after those workarounds, please write into us at support@doublefine.com and we will take a closer look. We apologize for the inconvenience and hope to have a fix soon!

Thank you to everyone who has joined us for the first few days of Kiln! It has been an amazing journey for the team and we’ve loved seeing all of your pot creations (please keep them coming)!

The team is also carefully tracking all of your reports and feedback and we are happy to share with you our first Kiln hotfix – for anyone who’s unfamiliar, hotfixes are smaller, more targeted updates to fix more pressing issues that you all might be facing! In this case, we have heard your reports and have two main fixes for you below:
Fixed an issue where players could become invulnerable after dropping into battle
Improved lobby finding
We are continuing to investigate other issues (if you are experiencing any problems, please write into

support@doublefine.com with your device and any screenshots/details you can provide), and we are continuing to track feedback (be sure to fill out our launch survey), so please keep telling us what you think!
Thank you all again for what has been an absolutely amazing first few days for us and see you all out in the Wedge!
